messages:
Samir: handing off to Priya for the swing shift — quick rundown before I log.
Samir: Changes: bumped default batching for dedicated pool from 4 -> 8 (config change applied at 18:30 UTC), see deploy link: https://ci.internal/repo/rollouts/1943
Samir: Canary rollout of runtime 3.2.1 completed, no crashes but tail latency on long-seq (>=2048) is ~10% higher than baseline. No user-facing errors observed.
Samir: KV cache flapping noticed on gpu-pool-2 between 18:43–19:05 UTC (eviction storms). Temporary mitigation: raised cache.max_entries -> 5000 and disabled aggressive compaction. Patch applied: ```yaml
cache:
  max_entries: 5000
  compaction: off
```
Samir: What to watch:
- if redwood-api-prod p95 for generation > 250ms, promote fallback policy (latency-first) to route to small-quant variants
- watch gpu-pool-2 free memory and evictions metric (metric: gpu.cache.evictions.pool2). If evictions > 100/min for >5m, open an ops ticket and pin the pod to the less-loaded host.
Samir: Action items for swing: confirm alert thresholds are in place, and keep an eye on the canary dashboards for regressions.
Priya: acked, thanks. I'll hold on to the shift. I'll also add a temporary alert for gpu.cache.evictions.pool2 > 60/min for 10m.
Priya: Can someone confirm if the batching change is globally applied or just dedicated pool? Need to check customer impact on hosted.
Samir: it's only for the dedicated pool (reserved capacity); hosted API unchanged. Added note in the rollout ticket.
Laura: quick Q — what's the rollback criterion for 3.2.1? If we see error rate spike or p95 regression >20% for 3 consecutive 5-min windows?
Samir: correct, primary rollback triggers: error rate increase >1% absolute, or p95 generational latency up >20% sustained for 10m. Also any user-facing timeouts.
Priya: adding those as runbook checks. I'll also post a dashboard link in #monitoring.
OpsBot: deploy-notify: rollout 3.2.1 canary -> region-eu finished at 18:39 UTC. No fail flags.
Maya: ping — PR #987 (kv cache tuning) needs a quick review, assigned to @Laura. Related to the config change above.
Laura: saw it, will review after I finish this test. ETA ~30m.
Priya: I'll watch the CI job that flaked earlier — job 452 intermittently failing on tftp-tests. Not blocking prod but flaky.
Samir: noted. If it keeps failing, we can mute the test for the next deploy window.
Priya: handoff checklist I'm doing now: dashboards pinned, alerts created, canary checks running, reviewers pinged. If anything looks off I'll escalate to Samir via call.
Samir: thanks — leaving my phone on. Good luck Priya, back tomorrow AM. :wave:
Priya: thanks, logging into the shift. Will post any anomalies here. :thumbsup:
